The Agents' instructions were to 'Please solve the programming task below in Python,' which implies generating the actual working code, not just an architectural design. By failing to verify that the specific task (writing the code) was fully satisfied by the current scope (architecture), the Architect prematurely terminates the workflow, preventing the Code Agent (Alex) from writing the solution. This leads to the final submission lacking the required executable code.
